s: Beezeh chapatzim muttar ledabber beshabbat ubo k"t seipim: "vekibbadto measot derakeka mimmetzo cheptzeka vedabber dabar", "mimmetzo cheptzeka" — dareshu chakamim: chapatzeka asurim lebaqqesham beshabbat, apillu bedabar sheeno oseh bo shum melaka, lo shel tora velo shebut middibre soperim, ella sheoseh ezeh maaseh hammuttar, apillu halika bilbaddah, umaaseh zeh o hilluk zeh hu bishbil kede laasot achar hashshabbat ezeh dabar sheasur laasoto beshabbat ben min hattora ben middibre soperim, shennimtza mazmin atzmo beshabbat bepoal mammash, lo behirhur lebad, ledabar haasur beshabbat, kegon shemmehallek besadehu lirot mah hi tzerika achar hashshabbat meiddur venikkush, vekayyotze bahem middebarim haasurim beshabbat, o sheholek lepetach hammedina veyosheb sham ad shettechshak kede lemaher latzet ballayla lammerchatz shechutz lair, shehare hilluk zeh hu bishbil chapatzim haasurim beshabbat:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennikkar haddabar shemmitkavven lachapatzim haasurim, kegon zeh sheholek besadehu, shemmah mebaqqesh sham im lo lirot mah hi tzerika. Veken haholek al petach hammedina nikkar haddabar shemmitkavven kede lehitqareb bammerchatz hassamuk lammedina, shekken haya bimehem shehammerchatzaot hayu semukim lepetach hammedina. Veken im metayyel bair kede limtzo sus o sepina o qaron lesokram achar hashshabbat latzet bahem ladderek, vehu beinyan shennikkar haddabar shemmitkavven lekak. Abal im hu beinyan sheen haddabar nikkar shemmitkavven lachapatzim haasurim ella lachapatzim hammuttarim — hare zeh muttar. Lepikak, muttar lehallek chutz lair tok hattechum ulehitakkeb sham ad shettechshak kede litlosh perot vaasabim migginnato vechurbato shebbetok hattechum velahabiam lebeto, sheen haddabar nikkar sheholek lesham bishbil telishat happerot, ki haroeh yomar shemma mechamat tirdat iyyuno belimmudo nimshak vehalak ad koh im hu talmid chakam, veim hu am haaretz yomar alayv shemma chamoro neebad lo umehallek lebaqqesho venimshak bebaqqashato ad shehiggia limqom happerot, veaz nimlak lehachshik alehem letolsham velahabiam lebeto ballayla, abal hilluko lo haya bishbil hattelisha haasura beshabbat ella bishbil habaat hachamor hammutteret beshabbat, veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

Abal asur lehachshik al hattechum, dehaynu lelek beshabbat ad sop hattechum (o emtzao) ulehitakkeb sham ad shettechshak, kede lemaher darko lelek mishsham ulehalea (shekkevan sheholek mishsham ulehalea bemotzae shabbat — nikkar haddabar sheiqqar hilluko haya bishbil kak, sheim haya hilluko lesham bishbil dabar acher velo haya bedato az sheyyelek mishsham ulehalea — min hassetam lo nolad lo sham dabar chadash shennimlak bishbilo) (lelek mishsham ulehalea). Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmachshik sham bishbil dabar sheen tzad hetter baolam laasoto beshabbat, kegon shetztzarik lelek chutz lattechum liskor poalim, o litlosh perot hammechubbarim, o lehabi mishsham perot hammuqtzim, sheen shum tzad hetter baolam liskor poalim beshabbat, o litlosh perot, o letaltel perot hammuqtzim. Abal muttar lehachshik al hattechum lehabi behemto michutz lattechum bemotzae shabbat, shehabaat habbehema hi dabar hammuttar beshabbat. Veap shei epshar lo lahabiah beshabbat michutz lattechum, mikkol maqom yesh tzad hetter baolam shehaya yakol lahabiah beshabbat michutz lattechum, kegon im hayu sham burganin, dehaynu sukkot shomerim, shekkol achat mehen mublaat betok shibim amma ved' tepachim shel chabertah, sheal yede zeh yakol lehallek apillu kamma parsaot beshabbat, mippene shekkullan nechshabot keir achat arukka, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"ch, veap al pi sheakshav en sham burganin. Veken muttar lehachshik al hattechum lehabi mishsham perot telushin sheenam muqtzim, sheyyesh gam ken tzad hetter baolam lahabiam mishsham beshabbat, kegon im hayu sham mechitztzot maqqipot et hadderek mimmeqom happerot ad beto, veap al pi sheakshav en sham mechitztzot (vehattaam yitbaer besimman sh"z). Abal perot hammuqtzim i epshar lahabiam ap al yede mechitztzot, kevan shehem asurim betiltul. Veken asur lehachshik al hattechum lehabi mishsham behema sheenah yekola lelek beragleha, kegon taleh qatan shetztzarik lenoso al ketepo vei epshar lahabio beshabbat ap al yede mechitztzot, mippene shehu muqtzeh veasur betiltul. Abal muttar lehachshik kede lishmor oto o perot hammuqtzim o apillu hammechubbarim shehem chutz lattechum, sheshshemirat hammuqtzeh vehammechubbar hu dabar hammuttar beshabbat. Veim keshehalak lehachshik lo nitkavven ella bishbil leshomram bilbad, veachar kak nimlak letolsham velahabiam lebeto bemotzae shabbat — hare zeh muttar:

Asur liqnot o limkor veken liskor o lehaskir beshabbat, gezera shemma yiktob, ben shemmoker o shemmaskir bepeh bilbad, ben shemmoser lo hayyom et hachepetz. (Veap al pi sheeno qotzetz immo deme hammiqqach vehassekirut, vaapillu eno mazkir lo shem damim kelal, ella sheomer lo leshon mekira o sekirut. Vaapillu tzarik liqqach maakalim leshabbat — lo yomar "mekor li", ella "ten li", kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"g. Vaapillu al yede nokri asur liqnot beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"z veshak"h ayyen sham):

Amira lenokri laasot beshabbat hi shebut middibre soperim ap al pi sheamar lo qodem hashshabbat, abal kesheomerim lo o leyisrael chabero beshabbat sheyyaaseh lo melaka lemachar — en bezeh mishshum shebut, ella sheasur mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka", veen hepresh ben issur zeh leissur zeh ella leinyan tzorke mitzva, sheasur laasot melaka al yede nokri apillu letzorek mitzva, ap al pi sheamar lo qodem hashshabbat. Vehu haddin lishar kol dabar shehu mishshum shebut — lo hittiru letzorek mitzva, ella im ken hu shebut dishbut, kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Abal keshehammelaka naaset bemotzae shabbat shehu zeman hetter ella sheomer lo beshabbat, veen baamira zo ella mishshum shemmitasseq beshabbat bedabar haasur hayyom eseq zeh — hittiru letzorek mitzva. Veken lehachshik al hattechum, sheen issuro ella mishshum shemmazmin et atzmo beshabbat ledabar haasur hayyom — hazmana zo hittiru letzorek mitzva, shenneemar "cheptzeka", chapatzeka — asurim, cheptze shamayim — muttarim:

Lepikak, machshikin al hattechum kede laasot chutz lattechum tzorke kalla o tzorke met, dehaynu aron vetakrikim velahabiam lair, veyakol lomar lachabero sheyyachshik al hattechum laasot debarim ellu velahabiam lo, veyakol lomar lo lek lemaqom peloni lemachar veim lo [timtza] bemaqom peloni lek lemaqom peloni, ap al pi shellidbar hareshut asur lomar lo belashon zeh, mippene shellashon zeh mokiach shemmeshallecho liqnot ezeh chepetz, shehu dabar haasur beshabbat, veyakol lomar lo gam ken beperush: qach bemaneh, veim lo [timtza] bemaneh — qach bematayim. (Sheap shehalloqeach mine maakal mechenvani beshabbat asur lehazkir lo shem damim kelal, mippene shekkeshemmazkir shem damim — hare zeh miqqach umimkar gamur, mah sheen ken kesheeno mazkir lo shem damim eno nireh kemiqqach umimkar ella kishela, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"g, veim ken gam keshemmeshallecho beshabbat liqnot bemotzae shabbat im mazkir lo shem damim — hare hu meshallecho lemiqqach umimkar gamur haasur lo beshabbat. Abal im lo haya mazkir shem damim — azay lo haya nireh shemmeshallecho lemiqqach umimkar gamur, ella lishela, mikkol maqom hazkarat damim kan hu letzorek mitzva, sheim lo yazkir lo lo yeda kamma damim lipsoq, veepshar sheyyachazor reqam im yeyaqqeru hashshaar vekevan shemmazkir lo haddamim leqinyan shelleachar hashshabbat — hittiru lo). Abal lo yazkir lo sekum miqqach, kelomar shello yomar lo sak yadua shello lehosip alayv, lepi sheamira zo enah ella hatztzalat mamono veen bah tzorek lemitzva. Veken lo yazkir lo sak damim, dehaynu shello yomar lo: lek leish peloni sheani chayyab lo kak vekak, veqach mimmennu tzorke hammitzva hazzot, veehyeh chayyab lo sak hakkol kak vekak (shetztzerup sak zeh en bo tzorek lemitzva):

(Vekol zeh keshemmeshallecho sheyyiqneh bemotzae shabbat, abal im nizdammen lo liqnot beshabbat vei epshar liqqach mimmennu behaqqapa beli sheyyiqtzotz lo deme hammiqqach, ap al pi shehu beinyan shei epshar limtzo chepetz zeh letzorek hammitzva ella beshabbat bilbad — asur liqnoto, shebbeshabbat atzmah lo hittiru liqnot apillu letzorek mitzva ella bederek hammuttar apillu lidbar hareshut, dehaynu behaqqapa, beli hazkarat shem damim, velo shem midda, velo sekum minyan, velo sekum damim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"g, veim chaser echad meellu — hare zeh shebut gamur kishar hashshebutim, shello hittirum letzorek mitzva ki im al yede nokri, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z):

En mistakkerin beshabbat apillu bedabar hammuttar, gezera mishshum miqqach umimkar. Ketzad? Kegon hassoker et happoel lishmor lo zeraim o dabar acher umeshallem lo bead kol yom vayom, vehu meshammerem gam beshabbat, shezzehu dabar hammuttar lishmor apillu perot hammechubbarim — lo yitten lo sakar bead yom hashshabbat bipne atzmo, veim natan lo — asur lo leqabbel mimmennu. Lepikak, en acharayutam alayv beshabbat miggeneba vaabeda sheshshomer sakar chayyab bahem, mippene shebbeshabbat eno shomer besakar ella bechinnam. Veim sekaro leshabua o lechodesh o leshana — lo yenakkeh lo keneged hashshabbatot, shello aseru ella littol sekar yom hashshabbat bipne atzmo, abal muttar littelo behablaa im shear hayyamim. Velo yomar lo ten li sekar hashshabbat, ella ten li sekar hachodesh o shabua o asara yamim vekayyotze bazeh, beinyan shehashshabbat mubla bachol:

Ap al pi shessekaro lechodesh, im hitna immo leshallem lo kak vekak bead kol yom vayom, ap al pi shemmeshallem lo besop hachodesh sekar hashshabbatot behablaa im shear hayyamim — en zeh kelum, shello niqra hablaa mah shemmablia lo yom hashshabbat bishat peraon, ella keshehaya sekar hashshabbat mubla biskar shear hayyamim bishat hashshemira, dehaynu keshehitna immo sheyyeshallem lo kak vekak bead shemirat kol hachodesh, abal zeh kol yom vayom sheshshamar nitchayyeb lo baal habbayit leshallem besop hayyom hassakar shel oto hayyom, shehare im hu rotzeh lo yishmor lo od, shebbishbil kak hitna immo leshallem lo bead kol yom vayom kede sheyyukal lehapsiq beezeh yom sheyyirtzeh, veim ken sekar hashshabbat hu bipne atzmo. Veap al pi shehu rotzeh ligmor shemirat kol hachodesh veen bedato lehapsiq beemtza hachodesh, mikkol maqom kevan sheim haya rotzeh lehapsiq beemtza hachodesh lo haya meshallem lo bead kol hachodesh, ella haya mechashsheb immo yom yom mime hachodesh kemo shenniskar lo, nimtza shessekar hashshabbat hu bipne atzmo. Veken haddin bemaskir cheder lachabero vehitna immo kak. Veken haddin bemalve beribbit lenokrim bead kak vekak leshabua — tzerikim lehalvot beinyan sheim yipreu hachob beemtza hashshabua yipreu haribbit bead kol hashshabua, o lo yipreu kelal hachob betok shabua zeh, sheim yukelu liproa beemtza hashshabua veyitztarek lechashsheb immahem hayyamim sheaberu mishshabua zeh, ap im yenakkeh lahem keneged yom hashshabbat sheabar mishshabua zeh — en zeh moil kelum, ella im ken yenakkeh lahem kol hashshabbatot sheaberu, shehare bekol shabua veshabua im hayu rotzim hayu poreim beemtza hashshabua, vehaya tzarik lachshob immahem yom yom mimot hachol, nimtza sheribbit zo hi nechshebet lekol yom bipne atzmo. Ulepikak, ap im abar kol hashshabua velo perao lo — eno rashshay littol kol haribbit, ella tzarik lenakkot keneged yom hashshabbat, kevan shekkol yom vayom hu nechshab bipne atzmo:

Veken haddin bekol qenasot sheqqonesim leadam kak vekak bead kol yom vayom sheober al taqqanat chakamim, kemo sheyyitbaer beeben haezer simman a"v, o al taqqanat tube hair, ap al pi sheaberu alayv kamma shabuot — eno meshallem bead hashshabbatot, kevan shehaya yakol lachazor bo beemtza kol shabua veshabua. Abal im haqqenas hu lenakkot lo mehachob sheyyesh lo al acherim bead kol yom vayom kak vekak — menakkin lo gam bead hashshabbatot, mippene shehaqqenas shennotelim mimmennu eno nireh kiskar netilat shabbat ella keshennotelim mimmennu ezeh dabar shehu been, abal lo keshemmenakkin lo mechob sheyyesh lo:

Asur liskor chazzan lehitpallel beshabbat o yom tob ap al pi shessekaruhu mibbeod yom, sheasur lo littol sekar shabbat o yom tob, vehu haddin liskar hattoqea berosh hashshana. Veyesh mattirin, mippene shebbimqom mitzva lo gazeru al sekar shabbat, sheen issuro ella mishshum gezerat sekirut beshabbat, shehi atzmah enah asura ella mishshum gezera shemma yiktob. Veken hamminhag lehaqel. Umikkol maqom, ledibre hakkol eno roeh simman beraka missakar zeh leolam, hoil vehu sekar hashshabbat, ap shehittiruhu letzorek mitzva. Veim hu muskar leshana o lechodesh o leshabua sheyyitpallel gam bechol umeshallemin lo bead hashshabbatot vehachol bebat achat — hare zeh sekar shabbat behablaa, umuttar ledibre hakkol:

Muttar lepaqqeach al isqe rabbim beshabbat, vaapillu lelek letartiot, dehaynu mine teraqlin shel nokrim sheshsham neespu lebet havvaad, veken lelek lashshilton lepaqqeach al isqe rabbim, veen bezeh mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka vedabber dabar", shetztzorke rabbim hem kemo cheptze shamayim. Umikkol maqom, lo hittiru ella lepaqqeach ulehitasseq bidbarim bilbad, sheeno asur betzorke yachid ella mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka vedabber dabar", abal kol dabar haasur mishshum shebut gamur — lo hittiru letzorke rabbim, kemo shello hittiru letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer leel:

Veken muttar leshaddek hattinoq leares, sheddibbur shel mitzva hu. Veken ledabber im hamlammed im rotzeh lehissaker lelammedo seper, o apillu lelammedo umanut, shezzehu gam ken mitzva, sheim lo tehe lo umanut leparnes atzmo — yelastem et habberiyyot. Abal asur liskor hamlammed (beshabbat, vaapillu) lehazkir lo sekum maot (asur), shezzehu shebut gamur, velo hittiruhu letzorek mitzva:

Veken muttar lipsoq tzedaqa laaniyyim, sheddibbur shel mitzva hu. Veeno domeh lemaarik, dehaynu sheomer "erki alay" o "erek ish peloni alay" legaboah, sheasur mishshum shebut gamur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"t, lepi shekkeshennoten legaboah kepi erek shanim shel hanneerak kakkatub battora — hare zeh keqoneh et hanneerak al yede shennoten erko legaboah, vedomeh lemiqqach umimkar, mah sheen ken bipsiqat tzedaqa. Velo aseru lehaqdish shum chepetz legaboah kemo sheyyitbaer sham, ella mishshum shekkevan shemmaqdish chepetz yadua — hare hu motzio baamira zo mereshuto lirshut gaboah, vedomeh lemiqqach umimkar, abal keshemmechayyeb atzmo sheyyitten ezeh dabar legaboah — adayin lo yatza shum dabar mereshuto al yede amira zo. Ulepi zeh, asur lehaqdish beshabbat lebet hakkeneset shum chepetz yadua, kegon seper tora, o atara, o tas leseper tora. Velo nahagu ken. Veyesh shellimmed alehem zekut, shello aseru ella lehaqdish chepetz lemizbeach o lebedeq habbayit, sheoto hachepetz yotze legamre mereshuto lirshut gaboah, sheen lo od shum zekut vecheleq bo, vedomeh lemiqqach umimkar. Abal keshemmaqdish chepetz lebet hakkeneset — yesh lo cheleq uzekut bo betok kol anshe hair sheyyesh lahem zekut beheqdeshot shel bet hakkeneset lemokram kesheyyitztareku, kemo shennitbaer besimman qn"g, veeno domeh lemiqqach umimkar sheyyotze hammiqqach legamre mereshut moker lirshut loqeach. Umikkol maqom, tob lizzaher keshemmaqdish chepetz lebet hakkeneset beshabbat, sheyyaqdishennu bepiv meereb shabbat apillu beno leben atzmo, veaz ap al pi shebbeshabbat mebio lebet hakkeneset — eno ella meparsem haheqdesh shehiqdish meereb shabbat, vezeh muttar ledibre hakkol:

Yesh omerim shebbemaqom shennohagin lomar leqore battora "mi shebberak" vehu noder litzdaqa o lechazzan — asur lo lipsoq kamma yitten, ella yomar lo setam "aseh li mi shebberak". Vehamminhag lehaqel bezeh, mippene shemmuttar lipsoq tzedaqa beshabbat. Abal mah shennohagim qetzat keshehechatan doresh beshabbat shehem mechayyebim atzmam litten kak vekak (maot) achar hashshabbat — lo yapeh hem osim, shello hittiru lechayyeb atzmo ella litzdaqa vekayyotze bah mishshear mitzvot, abal lidbar hareshut — asur mishshum "vedabber dabar". Veken hannohagim litten kelim bemattana lechatan haddoresh — lo yapeh hem osim, sheasur litten shum dabar bemattana lachabero beshabbat veyom tob, ella mine maakal umashqeh shelletzorek hayyom, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"g vetaqay"z, shehare apillu lehaqdish legaboah aseru, veheqdesh domeh lemattana sheyyotzea gam ken legamre mereshuto lirshut chabero. Vaapillu natan lo cheder verotzeh liqnoto al yede segirat haddelet, shehi niqret chazaqa leinyan shello yukal lachazor bo hannoten — asur lesograh beshabbat, sheen qonin qinyan beshabbat beshum derek middarke hahaqnaa, mippene sheddomeh lemiqqach umimkar. Veen tzarik lomar beqinyan sudar shessetamo omed liktiba, veshemma yiktob beshabbat (veayyen simman shl"t tashlum halakot ellu):

Mah shennohagin lehakriz mitzvot bebet hakkeneset mi sheyyitten yoter hu yizkeh bahen — haya rauy leesor mishshum miqqach umimkar, shehu shebut gamur velo huttar lidbar mitzva. Ella sheepshar leyashsheb hamminhag bedochaq velomar sheen shayyak miqqach umimkar bidbar mitzva, ki im bechepetz hanniqneh. Abal asur liqnot meqomot bebet hakkeneset o battim shel tzedaqa. Vehannakon kemo shennohagin miqtzat anshe maaseh, shekkol mah shehotzi bepiv litten — noten litzdaqa apillu qana chabero hammitzva, sheaz eno domeh kelal lemiqqach umimkar ella lipsiqat tzedaqa. Ubederek zeh muttar apillu liqnot meqomot ubattim mehatztzedaqa. Vekol yere shamayim yizzaher bezeh:

Mah shennohagim limkor haetrogim achar gemar mitzvatan — dinam kimqomot bet hakkeneset (sheen hetter ella bederek shennitbaer). Abal bizman mitzvatan sheen qonim otam ella latzet bahem yede chobatan ulehachaziram — hare dinam kehakrazat hammitzvot shennahagu lehaqel, sheeno qoneh gup haetrog ella mitzvato bilbad. Vaapillu beyom rishon shel chag shetztzarik liqnot gupo shel etrog, mikkol maqom kevan sheqqoneh oto al menat lehachaziro — nimtza sheeno qoneh oto ella mitzvato bilbad. Abal asur liqnot legamre et haetrog o hashshopar beyom tob, apillu im i epshar lo leqayyem hammitzva beinyan acher, sheen dochin shebut gamur mippene mitzvat aseh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqp"v vetaran"h:

Asur limdod shum dabar beshabbat, ben beyad ben bechebel, mippene shehu maaseh chol vezilzul shabbat. Umuttar limdod medida shel mitzva, kegon limdod im yesh bemiqveh m' sea, o limdod hachor im yesh bo poteach tepach lehabi hattuma mehacheder shehammet bo lehacheder hassamuk lo, veap al pi sheyyekolim hakkohanim latzet mimmennu lebayit acher, mikkol maqom kevan shehu moded shiure tora — eno nireh kemaaseh chol. Umuttar limdod haezor shel mi shekkoeb lo rosho velilchosh al hammedida kemo shennohagot hannashim, mippene shehi medida shel mitzva, umishshum hallachash en issur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z:
Ap lidbar hareshut en issur limdod ella keshemmitkavven limdod leezeh tzorek, abal im moded shello letzorek kelal ella kemitasseq bealma — muttar:
Mi shennishba liproa chobo lachabero bez' benisan vechal z' benisan beshabbat — yitbaer bechoshen mishpat simman a"g:

Muttar leharher baasaqayv apillu heak laasot melakot gemurot achar hashshabbat, shello aseru ella dibbur lebad, shenneemar "vedabber dabar", dibbur — asur, hirhur — muttar. Umikkol maqom, im yesh lo mittok hahirhur tirdat halleb o nidnud deaga — asur. Umishshum oneg shabbat mitzva shello leharher kelal baasaqayv, ella yehe beenayv keillu kol melakto asuya, vezehu shekkatub "sheshet yamim taabod veasita kol melakteka", veen adam yakol laasot kol melakto beshabua echad, ella yireh adam bekol shabbat keillu kol melakto asuya, veen leka oneg gadol mizzeh:

Asur lomar lenokri apillu meereb shabbat sheyyelek chutz lattechum beshabbat achare qerobe hammet sheyyabou lehaspido, sheen dochin shum issur mippene hespedo, shehare apillu im hebi hannokri meatzmo chalilin lemet lehaspido bahem michutz lattechum — asur lehaspido bahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h. Abal choleh shehikbid alayv cholyo veyare pen yamut umebaqqesh sheyyishlechu achar qerobayv — muttar apillu liskor nokri ratz sheyyarutz apillu kamma parsaot beshabbat lehabi qerobayv bemotzae shabbat, sheap shello hittiru sekirut beshabbat apillu letzorek mitzva — kan hittiru kede shello tittarep dato alayv im lo yaasu retzono:
Lehachalip mashkon lenokri beshabbat — yitbaer besimman shk"h:

Halloqeach bayit o sadeh beeretz yisrael min hannokri — muttar lo lomar lenokri liktob lo shetar mekira beshabbat im hannokri holek ledarko beshabbat, umaalehu bearkaot shellahem lachtom lo, sheamira lenokri beshabbat enah asura ella middibre soperim, umishshum yishshub eretz yisrael lo gazeru, ap al pi sheggazeru bishar mitzvot:

Mi sheobda lo abeda — muttar sheyyakrizu beshabbat shemmi sheyyodea bah yabo veyaggid, vaapillu haabeda hi dabar sheasur letaltelo beshabbat, mippene shehashabat abeda mitzva, velomar lemi sheyyodea mimmenna sheyyeshibenna — amira zo mecheptze shamayim shemmuttarim beshabbat. (Venahagu lehakriz gam al abedat nokri mippene darke shalom, sheanu metzuvvin middibre soperim lehitnaheg immahem bedarke shalom, vahare zeh keen mitzva, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h):
Im muttar lehacharim o lenaddot beshabbat o lehattir hannidduy vehacherem — yitbaer besimman shm"a:

Asur lehakriz beshabbat al qarqa hannimkeret, shekkol mi sheyyesh lo zekut aleha yabo veyaggid veim lav yobad zekuto, mippene shemmah sheomer "veim lav yobad zekuto", hu kedan et haddin, veen danin beshabbat. Veap im makriz setam "kol mi sheyyesh lo zekut yabo veyaggid", sheeno kedan et haddin, ap sheyyesh taqqana beir sheim lo yaggid batel zekuto — mikkol maqom asur mishshum "vedabber dabar". Ella shebbemaqom shennahagu lehaqel lehakriz setam — en limchot beyadam, ki yesh maqom lomar shezzehu ketzorke rabbim shemmuttar ledabber bahem beshabbat, shekkol dabar shehu tiqqun hammedina vehu mizdammen tadir niqra tzorek rabbim, kevan shehu mizdammen tadir. Umittaam zeh niqreu haddinin tzorke rabbim leinyan chullo shel moed, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqm"h. Umah sheen danin beshabbat, hu mishshum shehu shebut gamur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"t. Velo hittiru shebut gamur letzorke rabbim ella haddibbur bilbad, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal bemaqom sheen sham minhag zeh — en linhog ken lekattechilla:

Asur lehakriz beshabbat etzel mi sheyyesh yayin limkor im hu maqom shehayyayin matzuy bo harbeh, sheen tzorek mitzva behakraza zo, veasur mishshum "vedabber dabar". Abal bimqomot sheen hayyayin matzuy kol kak — muttar lehakriz alayv beshabbat, shezzehu tzorek mitzva liqnot yayin leqiddush velikbod hayyom. Ubilbad shello yazkir sekum maot, shezzehu asur apillu letzorek mitzva. Ella im ken makriz qodem "bareku". Vetob linhog ken leolam lehakriz qodem "bareku". Ushear mashqin asur lehakriz kelal achar "bareku" beshabbat, apillu belo sekum maot, kevan sheen bahem tzorek mitzva, ella im ken makriz qodem "bareku":

Mi shennoda lo beshabbat shehotziu nokrim et bitto mibbeto lehotziah mikkelal yisrael — mitzva lasum lederek peamayv lehishtaddel lehatztzalatah, veyetze apillu chutz ley"b mil, vaapillu im yitztarek laasot melaka gemura lehatztzalatah, vaapillu im hu sapeq im yatztzilenna, mippene sheinyan zeh hu kepiqquach nepesh shemmechallelin hashshabbat apillu bispeq hatztzala, sheen leka piqquach nepesh yoter mizzeh shello tetze mikkelal yisrael utechallel shabbatot kol yameha, umutab lechallel aleha shabbat achat mishshettechallel hi shabbatot harbeh, shemmittaam zeh gam ken mechallelin shabbat bishbil piqquach nepesh, sheomra tora "challel alayv shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harbeh". (Ulepikak, ap im habbat hi qetanna sheenah mechuyyebet adayin bemitzvot — yechallel aleha lehatztzilah, shello techallel shabbatot harbeh keshettagdil, shemmittaam zeh mechallelin shabbat lepiqquach nepesh haqqetannim). Veim eno rotzeh lehishtaddel behatztzalatah bechillul shabbat — kopin oto. Vehu haddin im enah bitto ella bat o ben ish acher ap al pi sheeno qerobo, veyesh yekolet beyado lehishtaddel bemitzva zo, ap al pi shehu sapeq im yatztzil — kopin oto lehishtaddel bekol mah sheepshar, apillu baasiyyat melakot gemurot im yitztarek lahen. Velo ameru she"en omerim leadam chate kede sheyyizkeh chabereka", ella keshechabero pasha bezeh, veal yede peshiato ba lo haones achar kak, kegon shehidbiq pat battannur beshabbat venizkar qodem shetteapeh, sheap shemmuttar lo lirdot min hattannur kede shello yabo hu lide issur chamur mimmennu — asur leadam acher lirdotah kede shello yabo chabero lide issur chamur shel apiyyat happat beshabbat, kevan shechabero pasha bemah sheshshakach vehidbiq pat battannur beshabbat, abal kan zeh shehannokrim rotzim leonso latzet mikkelal yisrael — lo pasha meuma. Abal im en rotzim lehotzio mikkelal yisrael ella sheonesim oto laabor abera achat, apillu laabod aboda zara, veachar kak yannichuhu lehachaziq dato — en mechallelin alayv shabbat beissur shel tora bishbil hatztzalato (ben hu beatzmo ben acherim), mippene shello nittena shabbat lidchot ella bishbil piqquach nepesh velo bishbil hatztzalat abera chamura mimmenna. Abal lechallel shabbat beissure dibre soperim muttar (apillu laacherim), kevan shehu lo pasha. (Vaapillu im en rotzim leonso laaboda zara ella laabor al mitzvat lo taaseh acheret shel tora. Abal bishbil mitzvat aseh en dochin shebut, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqp"v). Vekol zeh beyachid, abal lehatztzil rabbim meabera (chaser). (Ayyen sop simman tqp"v vetaran"h beture zahab, vetzarik iyyun bikhay gavna):
